evidence: Full mūrdhan explicitly gives Oriya muṇḍa head, but says these unaspirated forms may instead derive from or be crossed with muṇḍa shaven. It therefore does not settle the parent of the survey head element.

Full muṇḍa shaven/bald article gives Oriya stump/pollard and Gujarati shaven head, and is explicitly compared under mūrdhan for unaspirated head forms. This competing root cannot be collapsed into mūrdhan without evidence.

Full velā article documents time/daytime; its discussion permits l/r variation, but section 2 *veḍā specifically gives Oriya beṛa time. Local bela/bera/beṛa forms need branch-level review in addition to resolving the head element.
